messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we need an expedited deploy for kv-cache memory leak fix (v2.4.8-hotfix). Impacting EU1 embeddings at low volume, but risk of OOM under burst. Requesting fast-path approval to skip full canary and do staged 5% -> 50% -> 100% with strict smoke checks.

deploybot: Preflight checks: unit tests ✅, infra health ✅, staging e2e flaky (1/10) — non-blocking. To proceed with fast-path, operator approval required.

ryan: I'm on call, ack. I'm +1 to skip canary if smoke plan is tight. Who owns rollback?

sami: I'll own rollback. Image ready: gcr.io/redwood/kvcache:hotfix-20260320-rc2 (rollback image gcr.io/redwood/kvcache:stable-2.4.7).

maya: Smoke plan: deploy 5% for 10m, monitor /embed error rate and p95 latency. Rollback triggers: errors > 1% OR p95 > 200ms OR any OOMs in pod logs. Ops will cut if triggered.

deploybot: Deployment requested by maya. Rollout policy: fast-path (skip canary). Awaiting explicit operator approval to initiate.

ryan: approving (operator) — +1, proceed.

ashley: FYI I'll ping CS if we need customer comms. :thumbsup:

leon: I'll own alerting and circuit-breaker. Watching EU1 dashboards. :eyes:

deploybot: Initiating rollout: v2.4.8-hotfix -> service/kv-cache; stage 1: 5% traffic now.

leon: 5% smoke update: 0 errors, p95 steady at 78ms, memory trending slightly lower. No OOMs.

ryan: +1 to promote based on that.

deploybot: Promoting to 50% per plan (automated in 30s).

sami: rollback image pre-loaded to nodes and tagged. If we need to revert, I'll kick rollback and notify here.

deploybot: Rollout to 50% complete. Monitoring window active (10m).

leon: 50% hold: errors 0.02% (baseline), p95 85ms. No OOMs in logs.

maya: Good — if 50% stays clean for 10m, we'll go to 100%. Keep channels open.

deploybot: Promoting to 100% now.

leon: 100% check: still within thresholds. Small GC blip on one host, not OOM.

deploybot: Rollout complete: v2.4.8-hotfix deployed to 100% for service/kv-cache.

deploybot: Release note: "v2.4.8-hotfix — fixes intermittent memory leak under heavy kv cache updates; mitigates OOMs. Hotfix applied via fast-path staged rollout." Tagged: hotfix/expedite.

maya: Closing loop. Thanks everyone — follow-up: add brief changelog entry and notify impacted partners. I'll file a short postmortem if we see recurring leaks.

ryan: nice and smooth. Good job. :tada:
_meta: generated for dataset: hotfix deploy coordination & expedited approvals
